lead: Before the bot, you see the whole idea in a short script from the jornada-agentes repository: four folders, one task at a time, resuming after Ctrl+C, and failures kept separate with the reason.
objetivo: run the homemade queue, interrupt it midway, and explain why the second run doesn't redo what was already done.
hero_alt: Laptop with a dark terminal next to four paper folders on the table.

aprende.t: The four folders and the path of a task
Switching the engine: claude or codex

secoes.sub: Each request is a .md file that moves between folders.

nos.detalhe: Each .md file is one request, written the way you would write it in the chat. The order is the order of the file names.
The script moves the file here before calling the agent. If you hit Ctrl+C or the computer goes down, it stays here, and that is what makes resuming possible.
It worked (code 0 and a non-empty answer): the final file has the request, a --- line, and the agent's answer.
It errored or the answer came back empty: the file goes here with the exit code and whatever the agent printed. The queue moves on to the next one.

secoes.volta: On the next run: rodando/ → entrada/
secoes.legenda: Click each folder. The key trick is rodando/: a task only leaves there when it finishes, going to feito/ or to falhou/.

rolagem_fim.titulo: Running again only picks up what's left
rolagem_fim.texto: At startup, the script puts back into entrada/ whatever was left in rodando/. Whatever is already in feito/ is never redone.

secoes.sub: Run it, interrupt it halfway with the Ctrl+C button, and run it again.

msg.inicio: 5 tasks in entrada/. Click "Run the queue".
msg.rodando: Running: one task at a time, from entrada/ to rodando/ and then to feito/ or falhou/.
msg.parou: Interrupted. The middle task stayed in rodando/. Run it again to see the resume.
msg.retoma: Resume: what was in rodando/ went back to entrada/. What was already in feito/ is not redone.
msg.fimfalha: Queue empty. One task went to falhou/ with the reason: it's the one you check in the morning.

secoes.legenda: Illustrative simulation in the browser: the tasks don't actually run. The failure is on purpose, to show the falhou/ folder.

secoes.titulo: The script and how to use it
secoes.sub: It's in ferramentas/fila-caseira.sh in the jornada-agentes repository. Both engines run through your subscription.

blocos.conteudo:
git clone https://github.com/inematds/jornada-agentes.git
cd jornada-agentes
mkdir -p fila/entrada
echo "Resuma em 5 linhas o que é uma fila de tarefas." > fila/entrada/01.md
echo "Liste 3 riscos de deixar um agente rodando sozinho." > fila/entrada/02.md
./ferramentas/fila-caseira.sh fila          # default engine: claude
./ferramentas/fila-caseira.sh fila codex    # or codex

blocos.rot: The core of fila-caseira.sh (condensed for reading)
blocos.conteudo:
mkdir -p "$PASTA/entrada" "$PASTA/rodando" "$PASTA/feito" "$PASTA/falhou"

# resume: whatever was left in "rodando" (crash, Ctrl+C) goes back to the entrada
for f in "$PASTA"/rodando/*.md; do [ -e "$f" ] && mv "$f" "$PASTA/entrada/"; done

for f in "$PASTA"/entrada/*.md; do
  [ -e "$f" ] || { echo "fila vazia"; break; }
  nome=$(basename "$f")
  mv "$f" "$PASTA/rodando/$nome"          # grab the task (only one at a time)
  saida=$(claude -p "$(cat "$PASTA/rodando/$nome")" < /dev/null 2>&1); rc=$?
  if [ $rc -eq 0 ] && [ -n "$saida" ]; then
    # request + --- + answer go to feito/
  else
    # request + ERRO (rc) + output go to falhou/
  fi
done

abas.rot: What you see in the terminal

abas.html:
1. Creates the four folders (running it again breaks nothing).
  2. Moves back to entrada/ whatever was left in rodando/.
  3. Takes one file at a time and moves it to rodando/ before calling the agent.
  4. Code 0 and a non-empty answer: feito/. Otherwise: falhou/ with the code.
  5. At the end, it counts how many are in each folder.

abas.rot: What the bot does on top of that
abas.html:
• Receives requests through Telegram, not just through files.
  • Five queues with different limits, and automatic retries.
  • A deadline per task and a notice in the chat when it finishes.
  • An approval gate in the middle of the flows.

secoes.sub: Use two tasks from your queue on paper (lesson 2).

exercicios.texto: Create two or three tasks in fila/entrada and run fila-caseira.sh. On a second run, interrupt it with Ctrl+C while a task is in rodando/, check the folder, and run it again.
exercicios.pronto: the tasks are in fila/feito with the answer, and you saw the queue pick up where it left off after Ctrl+C.

secoes.sub: The explanation appears after your answer.

perguntas.p: You interrupted the queue in the middle of a task. What happens when you run it again?
opcoes: Everything is redone from the beginning.
The interrupted task goes back to entrada/ and the queue continues with what is left.
The queue only works again the next day.
perguntas.explica: This is what makes the queue durable: whatever was left in rodando/ goes back to entrada/, and whatever is already in feito/ is not redone.

perguntas.p: Why does the script move the file to rodando/ BEFORE calling the agent?
opcoes: To hide the task from you.
To mark which task is in progress; if it crashes, it stays there and gets resumed.
Because the agent only reads files from that folder.
perguntas.explica: Moving first is the record of "I'm working on this." It is the homemade version of inemaccbot's lease.

perguntas.p: The agent answered, but the answer came back empty. Where does the task go?
opcoes: falhou/, because an empty answer also counts as a failure.
feito/, because there was no error.
perguntas.explica: The script requires code 0 AND a non-empty answer. With no answer there is nothing to check, so it is a failure.
